import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
sc=bpy.context.scene
def mat(name,col,rough=0.5,metal=0.0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes=True
    b=m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*col,1); b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=rough; b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=metal
    m.diffuse_color=(*col,1)
    return m
M={k:mat(k,*v) for k,v in {"Asphalt":((0.05,0.05,0.055),0.9),"Grass":((0.08,0.3,0.06),1.0),"KerbRed":((0.8,0.05,0.03),0.6),"KerbWhite":((0.9,0.9,0.9),0.6),
 "Line":((0.95,0.95,0.95),0.6),"CarBody":((0.0,0.35,0.7),0.3,0.4),"CarAccent":((1.0,0.55,0.0),0.4),"Tire":((0.02,0.02,0.02),0.9),"Glass":((0.02,0.03,0.05),0.1,0.2),"Rim":((0.6,0.6,0.62),0.3,0.9)}.items()}

# centerline: rounded rectangle, CCW
A,B,R=40,25,15
pts=[]
corners=[((A-R),(B-R),0),(-(A-R),(B-R),90),(-(A-R),-(B-R),180),((A-R),-(B-R),270)]
for cx,cy,a0 in corners:
    for i in range(0,25):
        a=math.radians(a0-0+ i*90/24)
        pts.append(Vector((cx+R*math.cos(a),cy+R*math.sin(a),0)))
# densify
dense=[]
n=len(pts)
for i in range(n):
    p,q=pts[i],pts[(i+1)%n]
    k=max(1,int((q-p).length/1.0))
    for j in range(k): dense.append(p.lerp(q,j/k))
N=len(dense)
def tang(i): return (dense[(i+1)%N]-dense[(i-1)%N]).normalized()
def build_strip(name,w0,w1,z,material_fn,mats):
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm=bmesh.new()
    vs=[]
    for i in range(N):
        t=tang(i); nrm=Vector((-t.y,t.x,0))
        vs.append((bm.verts.new(dense[i]+nrm*w0+Vector((0,0,z))),bm.verts.new(dense[i]+nrm*w1+Vector((0,0,z)))))
    for i in range(N):
        a,b=vs[i],vs[(i+1)%N]
        f=bm.faces.new((a[0],b[0],b[1],a[1])); f.material_index=material_fn(i)
    bm.normal_update()
    for f in bm.faces:
        if f.normal.z<0: f.normal_flip()
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(o)
    for m in mats: me.materials.append(m)
    return o
W=6
road=build_strip("Track_Road",-W,W,0.02,lambda i:0,[M["Asphalt"]])
# kerbs only along corners: detect curvature
def curved(i): return abs(tang(i-1).angle(tang(i+1)))>0.01
kin=build_strip("Track_KerbInner",W-0.01,W+1.0,0.04,lambda i:(i//2)%2 if curved(i) else 1,[M["KerbRed"],M["KerbWhite"]])
kout=build_strip("Track_KerbOuter",-W-1.0,-W+0.01,0.04,lambda i:(i//2)%2 if curved(i) else 1,[M["KerbRed"],M["KerbWhite"]])
# center dashed line
me=bpy.data.meshes.new("Track_CenterLine"); bm=bmesh.new()
for i in range(0,N,4):
    p,q=dense[i],dense[(i+2)%N]
    t=(q-p).normalized(); nr=Vector((-t.y,t.x,0))*0.12; z=Vector((0,0,0.03))
    bm.faces.new([bm.verts.new(v+z) for v in (p-nr,q-nr,q+nr,p+nr)])
bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
cl=bpy.data.objects.new("Track_CenterLine",me); sc.collection.objects.link(cl); me.materials.append(M["Line"])
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1,location=(0,0,0)); g=bpy.context.object; g.name="Ground_Grass"; g.scale=(160,120,1); g.data.materials.append(M["Grass"])
# start/finish line on right straight (x=A, y=0)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1,location=(A,-10,0.035)); s=bpy.context.object; s.name="Track_StartLine"; s.scale=(2*W,1.0,1); s.data.materials.append(M["KerbWhite"])
import pickle
sc["center"]=[list(v) for v in dense]
print(N, (dense[1]-dense[0]).length)

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
M=bpy.data.materials
root=bpy.data.objects.new("RaceCar",None); sc.collection.objects.link(root); root.empty_display_size=1
def loft(name,sections,material):
    # sections: list of (x, [(y,z)...]) closed rings with same count
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm=bmesh.new()
    rings=[[bm.verts.new((x,y,z)) for y,z in ring] for x,ring in sections]
    k=len(rings[0])
    for a,b in zip(rings,rings[1:]):
        for j in range(k):
            bm.faces.new((a[j],a[(j+1)%k],b[(j+1)%k],b[j]))
    bm.faces.new(list(reversed(rings[0]))); bm.faces.new(rings[-1])
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=bm.faces)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(o); o.parent=root
    me.materials.append(material); return o
def ring(w,zb,zt,wt=None):
    wt=w if wt is None else wt
    return [(-w,zb),(w,zb),(wt,zt),(-wt,zt)]
# main wedge body (x forward)
body=loft("Car_Body",[(-2.2,ring(0.95,0.25,0.85,0.8)),(-1.2,ring(1.0,0.22,0.9,0.85)),(0.6,ring(1.0,0.22,0.72,0.8)),(1.6,ring(0.9,0.22,0.5,0.6)),(2.3,ring(0.75,0.22,0.32,0.5))],M["CarBody"])
# cockpit canopy
canopy=loft("Car_Canopy",[(-0.9,ring(0.7,0.85,0.95,0.6)),(-0.4,ring(0.7,0.88,1.28,0.5)),(0.2,ring(0.72,0.8,1.2,0.45)),(0.9,ring(0.75,0.72,0.75,0.7))],M["Glass"])
# front splitter & accent stripe
split=loft("Car_Splitter",[(1.6,ring(1.0,0.15,0.22)),(2.5,ring(0.95,0.15,0.2))],M["CarAccent"])
stripe=loft("Car_Stripe",[(-2.21,ring(0.18,0.86,0.9,0.18)),(0.6,ring(0.18,0.73,0.76,0.18)),(2.31,ring(0.18,0.33,0.36,0.18))],M["CarAccent"])
# rear wing
for y in (-0.6,0.6):
    loft("Car_WingStrut",[(-2.0,ring(0.04,0.8,1.3)) ,(-1.75,ring(0.04,0.8,1.3))],M["CarAccent"]).location.y=y
wing=loft("Car_Wing",[(-2.45,ring(1.05,1.3,1.33)),(-2.15,ring(1.05,1.33,1.42)),(-1.85,ring(1.05,1.36,1.38))],M["CarAccent"])
for o in [o for o in root.children if o.name.startswith("Car_WingStrut")]: pass
# wheels
wheels=[]
for x in (1.35,-1.35):
    for y in (0.95,-0.95):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=10,radius=0.38,depth=0.32,location=(x,y,0.38),rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
        w=bpy.context.object; w.name="Car_Wheel"; w.data.materials.append(M["Tire"]); w.parent=root
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=6,radius=0.2,depth=0.34,location=(x,y,0.38),rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
        r=bpy.context.object; r.name="Car_Rim"; r.data.materials.append(M["Rim"]); r.parent=w; r.matrix_parent_inverse=w.matrix_world.inverted()
        wheels.append(w)
for o in root.children_recursive:
    if o.type=='MESH':
        for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=False
print([o.name for o in root.children])
